source_audit.native_g38_provenance: EDC v3.1 GradeLevel codebook labels G38 as SEA-sourced aggregate grades 3–8. Use exact published ProficientOrAbove_percent only; EDC may sum achievement-level percentages within this native total. No grade aggregation is performed.
source_audit.tested_denominator: Unverified; retained raw but excluded from every model and interval.

state_lunch_notes.Error Message: The total Direct Certification was greater than the count of students reported as Free Lunch Qualified.
state_lunch_notes.State Note: NMPED started collecting and directly certifies (DC) Medicaid information starting SY23-24.  Medicaid can be reported as either Free or Reduced.  Since all DC is no longer all reported as Free, the number of Direct Certified can be greater than the Free Count.
